title: Insects and minibeasts
examples: Do all insects have six legs?
What are the three main body parts of an insect?
What do bees and ants eat?

explain.say: Today we are learning about insects and minibeasts. You will learn about their bodies and some types of insects. Say the word 'insect' with me.
Most insects have six legs. They also have three main body parts. These parts are the head, the thorax, and the abdomen. Say the three parts aloud.
Let us look at a bee. Bees have six legs and three body parts. They use their wings to fly to flowers. Can you point to the bee's legs?
Ants are also insects. They also have six legs and three body parts. Ants often work together in groups. They are very good builders. Say 'ant' loudly.

faq.q: Do all insects have six legs?
faq.a: No, not all creepy crawlies are insects. Some other bugs have different numbers of legs. You might also ask, 'How many legs does a spider have?' or 'Are all bugs insects?'
asks: How many legs does an insect have?
Do all bugs have six legs?

faq.q: What are the three main body parts of an insect?
faq.a: The three main parts are the head, the thorax, and the abdomen. The head has the mouth parts. The thorax helps it move. The abdomen holds other parts.
asks: What is the insect body made of?
Name the three parts of an insect.

faq.q: Are bees and ants the same kind of insect?
faq.a: Yes, both bees and ants are insects. They both follow the rules of having six legs. They are both important to nature.
asks: What do bees and ants have in common?

faq.q: Do insects always live in groups?
faq.a: Some insects, like ants, live in big groups called colonies. But other insects, like some butterflies, like to be alone. It depends on the species.
asks: Do all insects live in groups?

faq.q: What do the parts of the insect do?
faq.a: The head helps the insect see and eat. The thorax helps the insect walk and fly. The abdomen holds the insect's stomach and other organs.
asks: What is the job of the thorax?
What does the head do for an insect?

facts: The three body parts are head, thorax, and abdomen.
Bees use their wings to fly to flowers.
Ants are known for working together in groups.

quiz.say: An insect's body is made of how many main parts?
quiz.why: The insect body is correctly divided into three main parts: the head, the thorax, and the abdomen.

wrong.0: This is wrong because the body parts are specifically named three parts.
wrong.1: This is wrong because six is the number of legs, not the body parts.
wrong.3: This is wrong because the body has more than two sections.

quiz.say: If an insect has six legs, which body part helps it move its legs?
quiz.why: The thorax is the middle section that is responsible for movement, like walking and flying.

wrong.0: Wings are attached to the thorax, but the thorax is the main body section for movement.
wrong.2: The head is mostly for sensing and eating, not for moving the legs.
wrong.3: The abdomen is more for holding organs than for the main leg movement.

quiz.say: Which of these insects is known for building large nests?
quiz.why: Ants are famous for living and building in large, organized groups called colonies.

wrong.0: Bees also live in groups, but ants are often highlighted for their building skills.
wrong.1: Butterflies are usually seen flying alone or in small groups.
wrong.2: A spider is not an insect, so it does not fit the group we are learning about.
